note: RS5 lane api-reference: every GET of meta, market_data, instruments, search, explore, kite, desk, and public's refusal (D9). Run with --env BASKFY_SOLE_USER_ID=1 (the bed has no seeded e2e account; owner, id 1, is the sole tenant). Every case must be EQUAL. Cases prefixed verify- were added by the adversarial review (auth variants on every authenticated route, HEAD/POST/PUT and trailing slashes, path oddities, pydantic lax date/int/decimal/bool forms, huge and tiny Decimal amounts, every published basket's card/constituents/performance/kite).
